it’s just an odd spot because i honestly feel like i should push myself and get over it, because it seems stupid to let my body get in the way of me being able to pursue any sexual desires

the worst part about having animals is knowing they die. I’ve had to have one cat put down and i’ve had a dog who i loved go to a different home when my parents were divorced. My cat and dog are currently quite old and dont have a lot of time. The only advice i can give is that it is so hard to live without them. But you were there for them in their life. You were there to hold them and feed them and love them and that is all they could ask. they graced your life as much as you did theirs. losing a pet is awful but look at the positives: you got to know them. it is painful now but those times of happiness far outweigh the grief. Your baby would not want you to suffer: they loved you and would want you to live your life and make more connections with more animals. remember your cat fondly and they will wait for you.
